title: v3: scan-first LRU + probation list. New non-scan folios go to prob_list; first non-scan access promotes to main LRU. Evict order scan(>256) > prob > main. Hypothesis: readahead neighbours (~14KB/IO => ~3 junk pages per GET miss) were polluting LRU MRU end. Also: ablation 4ee45189 showed get_scan threshold fix only 516->547, so sampled-LFU itself loses to LRU (632).
